((('string', (('ID', "Whenever you perform the water ritual with a new creature, you gain an extra =repBonus= reputation. If you install this implant after you treat with a creature for the first time, you gain =repBonus= reputation the next time you treat with them.
Reputation costs in the water ritual are reduced by =ritualCostReduction=%.

entries.source:
Whenever you perform the water ritual with a new creature, you gain an extra =repBonus= reputation. If you install this implant after you treat with a creature for the first time, you gain =repBonus= reputation the next time you treat with them.
Reputation costs in the water ritual are reduced by =ritualCostReduction=%.
You may Proselytize =proselytizeLimitBonus.things:additional creature=.
Compute power on the local lattice increases this implant's effectiveness.
entries.baseline_translation:
每当你与一个新生物进行水仪式时，你额外获得 =repBonus= 点声望。如果你在首次与某生物相待后安装此植入体，则下一次与其相待时获得 =repBonus= 点声望。
